proof: A real episode_workflow row is seeded and claimed/acknowledged through EpisodeWorkflowCommandService.
O5 InitializeDecisionLoop, action, recovery, close, and reopen mutations execute through the existing VersionedAggregateCommandExecutor against that same row.
The regression asserts no ephi_decision_loop row exists and every successful O3/O5 command advances the same aggregate version.
DecisionLoopSnapshot.workflow_state derives top-level O3 work_state and its RevisionVector.workflow_version equals the aggregate version.
version_sequence: O3 acknowledge and O5 initialization contend at one expected version; exactly one commits and the stale contender conflicts.
O5 action, plan, lock, observations, closure, and reopen each advance episode_workflow under CAS.
O3 and O5 reads report the same authoritative CLOSED or reopened OPEN truth.

action_recovery_closure_proof.action_binding: A supplied prior_action_id must resolve in the same episode and active cycle; nonexistent IDs fail.
action_recovery_closure_proof.execution_state: UNKNOWN/PENDING actions cannot establish post-action recovery; qualifying action records require explicit observed/reconciled execution state.
action_recovery_closure_proof.temporal_boundary: Observations before the action observed/effect boundary remain history but are marked ineligible and cannot establish PASS.
action_recovery_closure_proof.closure_contract: CONFIRMED_ISSUE closure requires the exact locked PASS recovery_plan_id, its current-cycle qualifying action, and post-action evidence; closure retains action, plan, check/evidence IDs, revisions, workflow version, disposition, reason, actor, and time.
action_recovery_closure_proof.technical_pass: A technical recovery PASS does not change top-level O3 work_state; only CloseEpisode commits CLOSED.

reopen_history_proof.owner_reset: reopen deterministically returns the new cycle to OPEN with no retained old owner
reopen_history_proof.prior_history: prior checks, actions, recovery plans, observations, and closure records remain unchanged
reopen_history_proof.restart: PostgreSQL regression closes, disconnects, reconnects, reads CLOSED state, then reopens the same aggregate and verifies preserved closure history.

authorization_and_atomicity.current_authorization: revoked authorization blocks O5 read and protected write
authorization_and_atomicity.idempotency: same command ID and payload replays; same command ID with different payload/type/target conflicts
authorization_and_atomicity.rollback: audit and outbox faults roll back the shared workflow mutation
